standard_prerequisites.name: Componentwise description
standard_prerequisites.use: F_n = f_{n,*}G_n for the pushforward along a morphism of simplicial schemes.

standard_prerequisites.name: Cartesian criterion
standard_prerequisites.use: F is cartesian iff the degeneracy base-change maps are isomorphisms.

standard_prerequisites.name: Quasi-coherence characterization
standard_prerequisites.use: A module on the simplicial Zariski site is quasi-coherent iff componentwise quasi-coherent and cartesian.

core_obligations: Statement (lines 6552-6559): for f : V -> U cartesian with d^n_j : U_n -> U_{n-1} flat and V_n -> U_n quasi-compact and quasi-separated, the pushforward of a quasi-coherent module G on V_Zar is quasi-coherent on U_Zar.

Componentwise quasi-coherence (proof lines 6561-6567): F_n = f_{n,*}G_n by the componentwise description; the F_n are quasi-coherent by the Schemes pushforward lemma, G_n quasi-coherent by the simplicial characterization.

Cartesianness (lines 6568-6580): the base change maps along the degeneracies d^n_j are isomorphisms by the flat base change lemma for quasi-coherent cohomology and the cartesianness of G; hence F is cartesian by the cartesian criterion, and therefore quasi-coherent by the simplicial characterization again.
proof_roadmap: Identify the components F_n = f_{n,*}G_n and their quasi-coherence.
Prove the degeneracy base-change maps are isomorphisms via flat base change and cartesianness of G.
Conclude quasi-coherence from the componentwise-plus-cartesian characterization.
difficulty_reason: Pushforward lemma (statement 6552-6559, proof 6561-6580): pushforward preserves quasi-coherence under the flat/qcqs hypotheses - the proof assembles the componentwise description, flat base change isomorphisms along degeneracies, and the cartesian criterion; each step does a specific job with a named tool; complete as stated. H2.
